records.reason: Adds +2 to the extra damage a repertoire spell deals from Rage while you are Drained 2 or more (total 3). A real player-side damage increase, but it is gated on two states, so it belongs on a star, not a flat field.

situational.when: raging repertoire spell while Drained 2+ (Rising Blood Magic)

records.reason: A reaction that counteracts another creature's spell and refunds a slot; the counteract and the refund are resolved at the table, not on the sheet.
A spellshape action that makes your next spell ignore the TARGET's resistance to spirit/vitality/void; it changes the target's side of the exchange.
Makes enemies off-guard to you on the first round; it imposes a condition on TARGETS and only in an encounter's first round.
A 3-action activity that deploys a prepared snare into an occupied space; resolved entirely at the table.
Makes a creature off-guard for one improvised-weapon Strike; a TARGET-side condition the GM adjudicates (whether the foe knows your skill).
Reshapes the area of Wall of Fire when you cast it; a spell-shape option chosen at cast time, no player statistic changes.
A 10-minute exploration activity against a GM-set DC; the app does not model exploration activities, and the -2 Recall Knowledge penalty applies only inside it.
A reaction that lets you use Person of Interest on a new trigger without increasing its frequency; nothing on the sheet changes.
A 1-action activity that chains Take Cover into Hide in a specific environment; resolved at the table.
A bravado action; the Swim degree-of-success upgrade lasts only until the end of that turn and is rolled at the table.
A 2-action ability with a target save and positional outcomes; entirely table-resolved.

Grants the Opportune Riposte reaction, an ACTION resolved at the table. Opportune Riposte exists in core.json only as a classFeature/action record, and build.ts skips grantsFeats ids that are not feats, so no grant field could carry it anyway.
A rider on the Sweeping Fan Block reaction that turns caught ammunition into a Strike; resolved at the table.
Teaches your animal companion a new 2-action activity. Companion-side additions have an existing note-only lane (COMPANION_MODS, e.g. stealthy-companion), and nothing currently records it.

companionMod.note: Sweeping Tail (2 actions, requires a tail unarmed attack): the companion makes two tail Strikes against different creatures within its reach, increasing its multiple attack penalty as normal. On a hit it pushes the target back 5 feet, or 10 feet on a critical hit (forced movement).

records.reason: An activity that chains Envenom into a Strike and still spends a normal Envenom use; no stat changes.
A reaction that expends a prepared banishment on a critical hit; spell expenditure and the target's save are table-resolved.
A free action at initiative that swaps which companion is active; it changes no statistic, only which companion is on the field.
A reaction that substitutes your attack roll for an ALLY's failed check; it only affects an ally's result.
A 1-action Leap (or jump) that doesn't trigger reactions; a table-resolved action.

"You're permanently quickened" (extra action limited to Step/Stride/Fly, or your mount instead). No record field expresses a standing condition; the lane for it is the RECORD_MARKERS registry in src/rules/situationalBonuses.ts, which already carries identical entries for eternal-boost, panache-paragon, full-automation and perfect-readiness ({on:'condition',id:'quickened',value:'always on',note:...}). The aura half (allies' movement not triggering reactions) is ally-side and needs nothing.
Quickened on your next turn only when an enemy triggers your champion's reaction; a transient, event-driven state resolved in play.
A free action that ends a speed penalty or an immobilized/slowed condition; table-resolved condition removal.

Permanently changes the Sneak action for the player: move your full Speed (and Sneak while Burrowing/Climbing/Flying/Swimming). No record field covers an action-rule change; the lane is the RECORD_MARKERS action-mark registry in src/rules/situationalBonuses.ts, which already holds the same shape for feather-step, quick-unlock and quick-refugee's hide/sneak marks.
Modifies Tracking, an exploration activity the app does not model (full Speed while Tracking, no hourly check, concurrent exploration activity); the initiative Stride is a table-resolved free action.

A 2-action impulse granting a burrow Speed only until the end of your next turn (sustainable to 1 minute); no impulse in core.json carries speed fields because impulse durations are played out at the table.
Grants a swim Speed and a crit-failure downgrade to ALLIES near you; it changes only allies' statistics.
A 2-action Athletics-vs-Fortitude maneuver with damage and forced movement; entirely table-resolved.
A 2-action Strike against two adjacent foes; an attack action resolved at the table.
A 2-action activity chaining Escape into Steal; table-resolved.
A reaction that Repositions an adjacent enemy with replacement outcomes; positional and target-side.
Makes an enemy off-guard to your next melee Strike and suppresses reactions to your next ranged Strike; target-side conditions and reaction suppression tracked in play.
A 2-action ranged Strike using your melee weapon's own statistics with the damage retyped to spirit; an attack action resolved at the table, no standing change to the weapon.
A Strike that imposes immobilized on a failed save by the TARGET; target-side, table-resolved.

"The first time you hit a creature with an Aldori dueling sword each round, you deal 5 additional precision damage" is a flat player-side damage rider that nothing delivers. (The Dueling Lore-for-Intimidation substitution to Coerce/Demoralize is a skill-substitution action mark of the fancy-moves kind and is not covered by any record field.)

situational.when: first hit each round with an Aldori dueling sword

records.reason: Broadens which creatures your already-applied mortal weakness / personal antithesis affects; it changes the TARGETS' weaknesses, not your sheet.
Lifts the one-composition-per-turn and one-at-a-time limits; the sheet does not track composition usage per turn, so there is nothing to change.

"You learn the Symphony of the Unfettered Heart composition spell" — the spell exists in core.json but the feat carries no focusSpells, so a bard who takes it gets no spell. Every sibling composition feat (hymn-of-healing, song-of-strength, silvers-refrain) uses this exact field.
A reaction to Stride half your Speed without triggering reactions; a movement action resolved at the table.

Upgrades the Living Hair unarmed attack: d4 to 1d6 bludgeoning and adds the grapple trait. Nothing on the record delivers it; the identical witch feat Demon's Hair already uses unarmedTraits with match/add/stepDie.
"Your hair unarmed attack gains the reach trait" is a permanent change to a Strike you already have and nothing delivers it. (The hex-delivery half is a spellcasting rider resolved at the table.)
Lets your hair perform simple Interact actions and hold 1 Bulk; explicitly excludes anything requiring a check, so no statistic is involved.
Improves what ALLIES may do with the quickened action from Cadence Call and removes their slowed aftermath; ally-side only.
Adds two debilitation options to Debilitating Strike; debilitations are conditions imposed on a TARGET and chosen per Strike at the table (the app models no debilitation list).
A free action Stride at the start of an encounter that doesn't trigger reactions; table-resolved.

Two separate grants: "+1 to your maximum number of tactics prepared" is exactly the preparedTacticsBonus field (as used by efficient-preparation) and is missing. The other half — two new tactics added to your folio — has no lane: commanderFolioMax() in src/rules/build.ts is a fixed formula (5 +2 at 7/15/19) with no feat contribution, so a folio-size field still needs to be built.

Repeatable: "Add two additional tactics you qualify for to your folio." Tactics are real records (core.json `tactic` / actions with the tactic trait) and the folio is built by commanderFolioMax() in src/rules/build.ts, a fixed formula no record can influence. A folio-size grant field (repeatable, +2 each time) does not exist.
Lets you spend 2 actions on Direct Your Follower so the FOLLOWER gains an extra action; follower/ally-side action economy.

"At the start of each of your turns you gain an additional reaction that can be used only to make a Reactive Strike" — a standing, permanent player benefit. No record field grants extra reactions; the closest existing home is a RECORD_MARKERS action mark on reactive-strike in src/rules/situationalBonuses.ts, and no such lane for reaction count exists.
A reaction granting a Strike to you or your spotter after a miss; table-resolved and partly ally-side.
A reaction Strike against a creature moving to flank; an attack resolved at the table.
A 1-action Disarm with your tail that waives the free-hand requirement; a table-resolved maneuver.
A 2-action Trip against two adjacent creatures with a success-to-critical-success upgrade on that check only; resolved at the table.
A 2-action activity chaining Grapple with a net, Step, Interact and Strike; entirely table-resolved.
A 1-action activity that Boards and Takes Control of a vehicle; table-resolved.

Extends the investigator's attack stratagem (Int on the attack roll, and strategic strike eligibility) to one-handed club-group weapons, and removes the -2 for making a Strike nonlethal. Both are player-side attack-roll effects and nothing delivers them; the sibling feat athletic-strategist is already recorded this way in FEAT_SITUATIONAL.

situational.when: attack stratagem with a one-handed club-group weapon
situational.bonus: use Int on the attack roll; the Strike qualifies for strategic strike

situational.when: making any of your Strikes nonlethal

records.reason: Each day you make two temporary talismans of item level up to half your level (and know every common talisman formula of your level or lower). This is real gear appearing on the sheet at daily preparations. The only daily-item lane that exists is advancedAlchemy {items,addInt,atLevel}, which is alchemist-specific; a thaumaturge talisman allotment (count + item-level cap + formula access) has no field.

Lets one specially treated item hold two active talismans at once. The app enforces the opposite: attachKind()/the host rule in src/rules/attachments.ts allows a host at most one talisman, so this feat is actively contradicted by the engine and no field relaxes the cap for a nominated item.
Lets one Sustain action maintain a second battle aura; action economy resolved at the table.
A 1-action activity where you and your eidolon each Stride (or use a movement type you already have); table-resolved.
